exposure: cervical ripening with a 10 mg dinoprostone vaginal insert
absence of premature rupture of membranes (PRM)
cohort: Women who underwent cervical ripening with dinoprostone between January 1st, 2015 and September 30th, 2016 at the level III maternity ward of Angers university hospital
finding: The study developed a mathematical model to predict the mean time to delivery following cervical ripening with dinoprostone vaginal insert, integrating factors such as nulliparity, overweight, closed cervix, and absence of premature rupture of membranes.
